summary_1line: King Janaka recounts the lineage of his dynasty from King Nimi to himself while explaining the customary recital of ancestry during marriage negotiations.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Janaka stands before Sage Vasishtha in a royal court, respectfully recounting the long lineage of his ancestors.
An aged King Hraswaroma departs for the forest after handing the kingdom to his son Janaka and entrusting him with the care of Kushadwaja.
